description: This file defines the 'Option' model class for the OpenCart admin catalog module. It provides methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve product options and their descriptions and values from the database.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Model class for managing product options in the catalog, including CRUD operations for options, descriptions, and option values.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Creates a new option record in the database and adds its descriptions and values if provided.

methods.name: editOption
methods.description: Updates an existing option record and its associated descriptions and values.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Deletes an option record along with its descriptions and values.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option record, including its description in the current language.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of options based on filter criteria, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalOptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of option records.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description entry for a specific option in a given language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all description entries associated with a specific option.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all description entries in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific option, organized by language.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves description entries filtered by language.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a new value for an option, including descriptions in multiple languages.

methods.name: deleteValues
methods.description: Deletes all values associated with an option.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets details of a specific option value, including its description in the current language.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves all values for an option, ordered by sort order and name.

methods.name: addValueDescription
methods.description: Creates a description for an option value in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByOptionId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with option values for a particular option.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all option value descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: getValueDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all value descriptions organized by option value.

methods.name: getValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all option value descriptions in a specific language.
